title: I've made an AI toolkit that builds and playtests RPG Maker MV and MZ games
author: EachRequest
selftext:
Quick heads up, this is kind of self-promotion. It's a paid tool, but we also have free packs, so if you work with RPG Maker it might still be interesting.

We've been making RPG Maker games for ourselves and our friends for about seven years. Our drawer is full of games that never got finished, mostly because there was never enough time to place every door, chest and switch by hand and then test it all again.

So we built a kit that connects Claude to an RPG Maker MV or MZ project. Claude reads the project, builds maps and events from what you describe, and then plays the game in a hidden browser to check if it actually works. That last step made the biggest difference for us. Building is easy for a model, getting it right is not.

I dont think there's one right way to make games. Some people love doing every event and plugin by hand, and for them nothing changes. Some want a mix and hand off the boring parts. And some just can't do the technical side and would never finish a game without help. We wanted something that works for all of them, while the story, characters and design stay with the person making the game.

Kit: https://oasis-b.itch.io/living-world-kit-for-claude Manual: https://oasis-b.itch.io/living-world-plugins-docs

Feedback welcome, and happy to answer questions if anyone's curious how it works.
